description: Source code for the Goteo project's Blog Post model, defining the Post class with methods for retrieving, saving, and managing blog posts, including handling images, tags, comments, and filtering.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Model class representing a blog post with properties for post data and methods for retrieval, validation, saving, and filtering posts.

methods.name: sanitizeText
methods.description: Sanitizes input text by stripping disallowed HTML tags.

methods.name: getBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its slug, with fallback to ID if slug is numeric.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a post by its ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a post's data from the database by ID or slug, including related images, media, comments, and tags.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all posts, optionally filtered by blog, limit, and publication status.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves posts filtered by various criteria such as tags, author, section, and publication status.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates essential post fields like title, text, and date.

methods.name: slugExists
methods.description: Checks if a given slug already exists in the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the post to the database, handling images, tags, and updating related counts.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of translatable fields.

methods.name: allowed
methods.description: Checks if a post allows comments.

methods.name: numPosts
methods.description: Counts the number of published posts for a project and updates the project's post count.

methods.name: getListSections
methods.description: Returns list of blog sections from configuration.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns details of a specific section.
